left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  145 mmHg ≤ msSBP ≤ 190 mmHg
  -  Triglycerides < 500 mg/dL
  -  LDL-C ≤ 250 mg/dL
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  sSBP  [AND] ≥ 20mmHg and sDBP ≥ 10mmHg
  -  symptomatic orthostatic hypotension  [OR] and secondary/ [OR] iatrogenic hypertension  [OR] and dyslipidemia
  -  history of moderate to severe cerebral ischemia, [OR]  cerebral hemorrhage, [OR]  transient ischemic attack, [OR]  myocardial infarction, [OR]  or unstable angina in the past 6 months; severe heart failure (New York Heart Association functional class III and IV)
  -  hypersensitivity to telmisartan  [OR] or rosuvastatin
  -  history of angioedema after treatment with angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors  [OR] or ARBs; creatinine phosphokinase levels ≥3 times the upper limit of normal
  -  estimated glomerular filtration rate ≤30 mL/min; aspartate aminotransferase  [OR] and alanine aminotransferase levels ≥3 times the upper limit of normal
  -  potassium  [OR] levels >5

right.raw_text: 5 mmol/L; or any diseases that could affect the results of the study
